MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor Gorilla tape felt like a strong choice because I have repeatedly used Gorilla tape, and weather resistance adds a useful property for exposed repairs.",
    "Glue, electrical tape and wire connectors fit the repair supplies I have bought before, although that interest alone does not mean I need each one now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs, washers and T-taps require particular sizes or wiring needs; my earlier connector purchase does not establish that these would fit my next job.",
    "Ten tubes of glue and twelve rolls of electrical tape exceed what I currently need, even though the products themselves are relevant.",
    "Buying a handtruck does not mean I am building a cart, and my repair history gives me no reason to choose grinder wheels or locking nuts right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of repair supplies seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop hardware.",
    "My connector and handtruck purchases seem to have been stretched into needs for different electrical fittings and separate cart components."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Repeated Gorilla tape purchases give me a clearer reason to consider another useful tape variant than a single purchase gives me to consider loosely related equipment.",
    "The exact application, dimensions and quantity matter: a related supply is only worth choosing when it fits a real repair and a manageable amount."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but too often assumed I currently need loosely related parts or large quantities."
}
